female.sp: Dahgi Iris XM-06 from Gundam F91, original Crossbone Vanguard version. Preserve its distinctive reconnaissance sensor head accents as face-framing mechanical ornaments, rounded armor shells, characteristic shoulder silhouette, compact beam rifle and mounted shield. Elegant mechanical reconnaissance knight with clearly human face and body. Original Crossbone Vanguard colors: deep forest-green main armor, burgundy-red chest and burgundy physical shield with a small restrained gold emblem, dark charcoal joints. Do not use the ivory Earth Federation repaint. Sensor-equipped rounded shoulder shells and a dorsal reconnaissance radar backpack must remain recognizable. Avoid generic fantasy armor. Normal human anatomy: one human head with clearly visible face, two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand; no robot face or extra limbs. Keep recognizable shoulder armor. Subtle adult sensuality. No camera pullback to create margins; maintain close full-body framing with feet and major equipment visible.
